title: kei.policy-set/v1
description: The policy catalog's policy model for one workspace, in evaluation order: policies, groups, tools, connectors and agents. It mirrors kei-policy-catalog pkg/database/policies.go and connector_policy.go. It carries metadata only (ADR-011): no credentials, provider payloads, results or subject memberships. The $id is an identifier, not a fetchable URL.

match_semantics.description: The pattern-matching dialect every evaluator must implement byte-for-byte. kei.match/v1 is kei-policy-catalog pkg/policy.MatchesPattern with strict semantics (HAI-248) plus the connector src/dst candidate lists in connector_policy.go, as defined in ADR-028 section 5: exact case-sensitive match except *, <scheme>:*, and the case-insensitive *@<domain> email form; a star anywhere else is a literal and no form matches a prefix or suffix. Harness command policies (dst schemes shell:, skill:, path:, mcp: and harness tool: names; src harness:) are evaluated by the separate kei.harness-match/v1 dialect that the policy bundle declares (ADR-029); kei.match/v1 itself is unchanged.

order.description: policies[] is already in evaluation order. The catalog sorts at publish time (priority DESC, deny before permit at equal priority, id ASC; ADR-028 section 2); evaluators walk the array and the first policy whose src and dst both match decides.

default.description: The decision when no policy matches. Always deny (fail closed).

id.description: An opaque identifier. The catalog emits UUIDs; test fixtures use readable handles such as ws-fixture-0001.

src_pattern.description: Who a policy applies to: user:<id>, email:<address>, agent:<id>, org:<role>, group:<name>, harness:<harness_id> or harness:<kind> (ADR-029; evaluated only on harness command requests, and only with a harness-command dst or *), <scheme>:*, the *@<domain> email-domain form, or *. There is no general *<suffix> wildcard (ADR-028 section 5).

dst_pattern.description: What a policy applies to: tool:<name>, connector:<id>, capability:<name>, resource:<resource>, the legacy <action>:<resource> form, <scheme>:*, or *. There is no *<suffix> wildcard; a star anywhere else is a literal (ADR-028 section 5). The schemes shell:, skill:, path: and mcp: are reserved for harness commands (ADR-029): they are literals under kei.match/v1, are never generated as connector or authorize candidates, and are interpreted only by kei.harness-match/v1. For harness rendering, tool:<kind>.<name> also matches registered harness tools (built-ins, <kind>.skill.<name>, <kind>.mcp.<server>.<tool>); a permit with *, shell:* or the shell tool's tool: name is never rendered as a native shell allow (ADR-029 section 9.4). shell:<t1> <t2> ... is an argv-token prefix whose tokens are separated by single spaces; it is the only form that may contain whitespace.

child_group_ids.description: Containment edges (ADR-015): this group contains these groups, so a member of this group effectively belongs to them too.

service.description: Credential-lookup service. Empty means policy-only (no credential).

action.description: The action string the runtime sends to the evaluator for this tool, e.g. github:read or tool:search_wiki.
The policy's effect (ADR-028 section 3), kept under its legacy field name in v1.

enabled.description: Only enabled policies are published; a disabled row never appears in a policy set.

approval_required.description: Retained for schema compatibility. Per ADR-027, this field is no longer evaluated by the bundle PEP. Approvals grant workspace access, not per-call permission.

org_id.description: null only for a global platform default.

workspace_id.description: null for a global default or a legacy org-scoped policy, which applies only in the org's default workspace.

agent_id.description: When set, the policy is eligible only for calls made by this agent.
